title: M3(R2): Guidance on Nonclinical Safety Studies for the Conduct of Human Clinical Trials and Marketing Authorization for Pharmaceuticals
scope: Timing, duration and scope of nonclinical safety studies supporting each clinical phase and MAA; exploratory IND approaches.
oligo_applicability: Default framework for synthetic oligonucleotides (small-molecule-like pathway). FDA Nov 2024 draft and Japan 2020 guideline modify it (e.g., rodent + non-rodent species, hybridization-dependent off-target assessment, chronic tox duration). Q&A (R2) 2012: https://database.ich.org/sites/default/files/M3_R2__Q%26As_R2__Q%26As.pdf

title: S9: Nonclinical Evaluation for Anticancer Pharmaceuticals
scope: Reduced nonclinical package for pharmaceuticals intended to treat patients with advanced cancer (e.g., no separate safety-pharmacology studies, limited genotox/reprotox before MAA).
oligo_applicability: Applies to oligonucleotides for advanced cancer indications (e.g., fusion-oncogene ASOs); S9 Q&A (2018) clarifies paediatric oncology first-in-paediatric dosing and when S9 vs M3(R2) governs. Q&A: https://database.ich.org/sites/default/files/S9_Q%26As_Q%26As.pdf

title: S2(R1): Guidance on Genotoxicity Testing and Data Interpretation for Pharmaceuticals Intended for Human Use
scope: Standard battery of in vitro/in vivo genotoxicity tests and interpretation.
oligo_applicability: Standard battery generally expected for oligonucleotides with novel chemistries; OSWG genotoxicity paper (2016) and FDA 2024 draft discuss when a reduced battery is justified for well-characterised backbone/sugar chemistries.

title: S1A: Guideline on the Need for Carcinogenicity Studies of Pharmaceuticals
scope: Circumstances under which carcinogenicity studies are required (chronic use >= 6 months, cause for concern).
oligo_applicability: Oligonucleotides for chronic use fall under S1A; S1B(R1) weight-of-evidence approach may waive the 2-year rat study for ASO/siRNA when hybridization-independent class effects are characterised.
verification: K (URL pattern consistent with database.ich.org but not surfaced in search)

title: S1B(R1): Testing for Carcinogenicity of Pharmaceuticals
scope: Integrated weight-of-evidence (WoE) approach that may replace the 2-year rat carcinogenicity study; rasH2 and plasma-exposure ratio addenda.
oligo_applicability: WoE approach is the principal route to waiving 2-year rat bioassays for chronic-use oligonucleotides; FDA Nov 2024 draft refers to it.

title: S1C(R2): Dose Selection for Carcinogenicity Studies of Pharmaceuticals
scope: High-dose selection criteria for carcinogenicity studies (MTD, 25x exposure, saturation, MFD).
oligo_applicability: Applies when a carcinogenicity study is run; exposure-based dose selection is complicated by tissue accumulation of oligonucleotides.

title: S5(R3): Detection of Reproductive and Developmental Toxicity for Human Pharmaceuticals
scope: Reproductive/developmental toxicity testing strategy, including alternative assays and exposure-margin considerations.
oligo_applicability: Applies; OSWG reproductive-toxicity white paper (2014) and FDA 2024 draft discuss species selection (limited placental transfer of oligonucleotides) and when DART may be deferred.

title: S7A: Safety Pharmacology Studies for Human Pharmaceuticals
scope: Core battery (CNS, cardiovascular, respiratory) safety-pharmacology studies before first-in-human.
oligo_applicability: Applies; OSWG safety pharmacology recommendations (2014) adapt the core battery (often integrated into repeat-dose tox in NHP).

title: S7B: The Non-clinical Evaluation of the Potential for Delayed Ventricular Repolarization (QT Interval Prolongation) by Human Pharmaceuticals
scope: Nonclinical hERG/in vivo QT assessment strategy.
oligo_applicability: FDA June 2024 clinical pharmacology guidance notes oligonucleotides are unlikely hERG blockers; integrated nonclinical/clinical QT assessment per E14/S7B Q&A can replace a thorough QT study.

title: E14/S7B Questions and Answers: Clinical and Nonclinical Evaluation of QT/QTc Interval Prolongation and Proarrhythmic Potential
scope: Integrated nonclinical-clinical QT risk assessment; use of concentration-QTc modelling and nonclinical data to support waiving a TQT study.
oligo_applicability: Directly cited by the FDA oligonucleotide clinical pharmacology guidance as the route to characterise QTc risk without a dedicated TQT study.
notes: A file named 'ICH E14_S7B Q&As(R1) 2026_2008.pdf' also appears on database.ich.org, suggesting an (R1) update in 2026; not opened - verify before citing.

title: S3A: Note for Guidance on Toxicokinetics: The Assessment of Systemic Exposure in Toxicity Studies
scope: Toxicokinetic data collection in toxicity studies; Q&A (2017) on microsampling.
oligo_applicability: Applies; tissue (liver/kidney) concentrations rather than plasma AUC often drive exposure assessment for oligonucleotides (see OSWG ADME paper 2023). Q&A: https://database.ich.org/sites/default/files/S3A_Q%26As_Q%26As.pdf
verification: Q&A URL V-SEARCH; main guideline URL K

title: S6(R1): Preclinical Safety Evaluation of Biotechnology-Derived Pharmaceuticals
scope: Nonclinical programme for biotechnology-derived products (proteins, mAbs): species selection by pharmacological relevance, immunogenicity, flexible study design.
oligo_applicability: APPLICABILITY NOTE: chemically synthesised oligonucleotides are outside S6 scope (S6 excludes synthetic products); they are evaluated under M3(R2)/S-series. S6(R1) applies to the antibody component of antibody-oligonucleotide conjugates (AOCs) and to protein carriers; expect hybrid programmes (S6 for mAb, M3/S2/S7 for the oligo payload and linker).

title: S11: Nonclinical Safety Testing in Support of Development of Paediatric Pharmaceuticals
scope: WoE approach to decide whether juvenile animal studies are needed; design of juvenile toxicity studies.
oligo_applicability: Applies to paediatric oligonucleotide programmes (e.g., nusinersen-type intrathecal ASOs); juvenile NHP/rat studies are frequently requested for CNS-delivered oligos.

title: Q1A(R2): Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products
status: in force (Step 4/5); to be superseded by consolidated ICH Q1
scope: Stability study design, storage conditions, testing frequency for new drug substances/products. Family: Q1B (photostability, 1996), Q1C (new dosage forms, 1996), Q1D (bracketing/matrixing, 2002), Q1E (evaluation of stability data, 2003).
oligo_applicability: Applies to oligonucleotide drug substance (often lyophilised or solution) and product; EMA draft oligo guideline cross-refers for stability of active substance in solution.

title: Q1: Stability Testing of Drug Substances and Drug Products (consolidated revision of Q1A-Q1F and Q5C)
status: draft (Step 2 April 2025; Step 3 consultation closed Sept 2025; Step 4 planned Nov 2026)
scope: Single consolidated stability guideline replacing Q1A-Q1F and Q5C; adds modelling, reduced designs, in-use stability, advanced therapies annex.
oligo_applicability: Will become the governing stability text for oligonucleotide substances/products once at Step 4/5; monitor Nov 2026 ICH meeting outcome.
verification: Step 2 PDF V-SEARCH; status from ICH Q1 EWG work plan (V-PAGE, 2026-03-18)

title: Q2(R2): Validation of Analytical Procedures
scope: Validation of analytical procedures incl. multivariate and spectroscopic methods.
oligo_applicability: Applies to oligonucleotide release/stability methods (IP-RP-HPLC, AEX, LC-MS for sequence/impurities, hybridisation assays).

title: Q14: Analytical Procedure Development
scope: Science- and risk-based analytical procedure development, analytical target profile, lifecycle management.
oligo_applicability: Supports platform analytical approaches for oligonucleotide families (relevant to individualised ASO and multi-sequence programmes).
verification: K (Step 2 version surfaced in search; final filename from knowledge)

title: Q3A(R2): Impurities in New Drug Substances
scope: Reporting, identification and qualification thresholds for impurities in new chemical drug substances.
oligo_applicability: Default thresholds are generally NOT directly applicable to oligonucleotide process-related impurities (n-1, n+1, PO-containing, depurinated species); EMA draft oligo guideline and Japan PtC propose impurity-class-based specification approaches; justify deviations.

title: Q3B(R2): Impurities in New Drug Products
scope: Degradation product thresholds in new drug products.
oligo_applicability: Same caveat as Q3A: degradation products of oligonucleotides are typically controlled as classes; thresholds need justification.

title: Q3C(R9): Impurities: Guideline for Residual Solvents
scope: PDE limits for residual solvents.
oligo_applicability: Applies to solid-phase synthesis solvents (acetonitrile, toluene, pyridine, DCM) in oligonucleotide drug substance.

title: Q3D(R2): Guideline for Elemental Impurities
scope: Risk-based control of elemental impurities incl. cutaneous/transdermal PDEs.
oligo_applicability: Applies (e.g., residual metals from synthesis reagents and LNP/GalNAc conjugation chemistry).

title: Q3E: Guideline for Extractables and Leachables (E&L)
scope: Harmonised assessment and control of extractables and leachables from container closure and manufacturing systems.
oligo_applicability: Relevant to prefilled syringes/vials for subcutaneous GalNAc-siRNA and intrathecal ASO products; still draft.

title: Q6A: Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria for New Drug Substances and New Drug Products: Chemical Substances
scope: Setting specifications for chemical drug substances/products; decision trees.
oligo_applicability: Oligonucleotides are treated as chemical entities (Q6A rather than Q6B) in EU/US; the EMA draft oligo guideline supplements Q6A for sequence identity, impurity classes and potency.

title: Q11: Development and Manufacture of Drug Substances (Chemical Entities and Biotechnological/Biological Entities)
scope: Drug substance development, starting-material selection, control strategy; Q&A (2017) on starting materials.
oligo_applicability: Starting-material designation (phosphoramidites, solid support, conjugate moieties such as GalNAc) for oligonucleotides is a known point of divergence; EMA draft oligo guideline gives specific expectations. Q&A: https://database.ich.org/sites/default/files/Q11_Q%26As_Q%26As.pdf

title: M7(R2): Assessment and Control of DNA Reactive (Mutagenic) Impurities in Pharmaceuticals to Limit Potential Carcinogenic Risk
scope: Control of mutagenic impurities (TTC approach); addendum with compound-specific limits.
oligo_applicability: Applies to reagent-derived impurities (e.g., alkylating agents, nitrosamine precursors) in oligonucleotide synthesis; oligonucleotide-related impurities themselves are usually assessed as non-mutagenic by class.

title: M10: Bioanalytical Method Validation and Study Sample Analysis
scope: Validation of chromatographic and ligand-binding bioanalytical assays for PK/TK.
oligo_applicability: Applies to oligonucleotide PK assays (hybridisation-ELISA, LC-MS); FDA clin-pharm oligo guidance expects characterisation of metabolites and tissue exposure.

title: E6(R3): Guideline for Good Clinical Practice (Principles, Annex 1, Annex 2; consolidated 2026)
status: in force; Principles+Annex 1 Step 4 2025-01-06 (EU effective 2025-07-23); Annex 2 Step 4 2026-06-03, consolidated Step 4 2026-06-16 (EU effective 2027-01-15)
scope: GCP principles; Annex 1 interventional trials; Annex 2 non-traditional designs (pragmatic, decentralised, RWD elements).
oligo_applicability: Applies to all oligonucleotide trials; Annex 2 is relevant to n-of-1/individualised ASO trials using RWD and remote data collection.
verification: V-PAGE (EMA E6 page + PMDA copy of consolidated text)

title: E8(R1): General Considerations for Clinical Studies
scope: Quality by design of clinical studies; critical-to-quality factors; study types across development.
oligo_applicability: General applicability; supports fit-for-purpose designs in rare-disease oligonucleotide programmes.

title: E9: Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials
scope: Statistical design, conduct and analysis principles for confirmatory trials.
oligo_applicability: General applicability.

title: E9(R1): Addendum on Estimands and Sensitivity Analysis in Clinical Trials
scope: Estimand framework and sensitivity analyses.
oligo_applicability: General applicability; estimands matter for externally controlled rare-disease trials (plausible mechanism/RDEP pathways).

title: E11(R1): Addendum: Clinical Investigation of Medicinal Products in the Pediatric Population
scope: Paediatric development principles: extrapolation, modelling, age classification, ethics, formulations.
oligo_applicability: Applies to paediatric oligonucleotide programmes (SMA, DMD, Batten, paediatric cancers).

title: E11A: Pediatric Extrapolation
scope: Framework for extrapolating efficacy/safety from adults or other paediatric groups; use of modelling and Bayesian methods.
oligo_applicability: Supports mechanism-based extrapolation for oligonucleotides whose target biology is shared across ages (e.g., TTR silencers, oncogene-targeted ASOs).

title: E17: General Principles for Planning and Design of Multi-Regional Clinical Trials
scope: Design of MRCTs acceptable across ICH regions; pooled regions; sample-size allocation.
oligo_applicability: Relevant for global rare-disease oligonucleotide trials where per-region enrolment is tiny.

title: M4(R4): Organisation of the Common Technical Document for the Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (with M4Q(R1), M4S(R2), M4E(R2))
scope: CTD structure for MAA/NDA/BLA. Module-specific guidelines: Quality https://database.ich.org/sites/default/files/M4Q_R1_Guideline.pdf ; Safety https://database.ich.org/sites/default/files/M4S_R2_Guideline.pdf ; Efficacy https://database.ich.org/sites/default/files/M4E_R2__Guideline.pdf
oligo_applicability: Oligonucleotide dossiers use Module 3 as for chemical entities (3.2.S for drug substance incl. conjugate); EMA draft oligo guideline maps content to CTD sections.

title: M4Q(R2): The Common Technical Document for the Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use: Quality (revision)
status: draft (Step 2 May 2025; consultation closed March 2026; Step 4 planned June 2027)
scope: Restructured Module 2.3/3 with product-lifecycle and control-strategy sections; new Module 3.2.R expectations.
oligo_applicability: Will change how oligonucleotide CMC data are organised once adopted; not yet applicable.
verification: EMA Step 2b PDF V-SEARCH; status from ICH M4Q(R2) EWG work plan (V-PAGE, 2026-08-18)

title: Clinical Pharmacology Considerations for the Development of Oligonucleotide Therapeutics (Guidance for Industry)
status: final (June 2024; FR notice 2024-06-17, FR Doc. 2024-13271; supersedes draft of 2022-06-27, 87 FR 38161)
scope: QTc/proarrhythmia assessment, immunogenicity (ADA), hepatic and renal impairment, PK- and PD-based drug-drug interaction liability for oligonucleotide therapeutics.
oligo_applicability: Core FDA clinical-pharmacology expectations for ASO, siRNA, aptamers and conjugates (GalNAc); states TQT study generally not needed if nonclinical/clinical integrated assessment is negative.
verification: V-PAGE (FR notice via justia; FDA podcast page); media URL V-SEARCH

title: Nonclinical Safety Assessment of Oligonucleotide-Based Therapeutics (Draft Guidance for Industry)
status: draft (Nov 2024; comment period closed; not finalised as of 2026-10-28 per FDA page)
scope: Nonclinical programme for ASO/siRNA/aptamers: species selection (rodent + NHP), hybridisation-dependent on-/off-target assessment, class effects (complement, thrombocytopenia, renal/hepatic), genotox, carcinogenicity (WoE), DART, juvenile studies, conjugates.
oligo_applicability: Directly applicable; harmonises with Japan 2020 guideline and OSWG recommendations; first FDA-wide nonclinical oligo guidance beyond the individualised-ASO documents.

title: IND Submissions for Individualized Antisense Oligonucleotide Drug Products: Administrative and Procedural Recommendations (Guidance for Sponsor-Investigators)
scope: Pre-IND interaction, IND content and timing for n-of-1/n-of-few ASOs for severely debilitating or life-threatening (SDLT) genetic diseases.
oligo_applicability: Applies to academic/sponsor-investigator bespoke ASO programmes (Milasen-type).

title: Nonclinical Testing of Individualized Antisense Oligonucleotide Drug Products for Severely Debilitating or Life-Threatening Diseases (Guidance for Sponsor-Investigators)
scope: Minimum nonclinical package (single-species, abbreviated tox, off-target screening) to support an IND for a patient-specific ASO.
oligo_applicability: Applies to individualised ASOs for one or two identified patients; reference point for the 2026 plausible-mechanism framework.

title: IND Submissions for Individualized Antisense Oligonucleotide Drug Products for Severely Debilitating or Life-Threatening Diseases: Clinical Recommendations (Guidance for Sponsor-Investigators)
scope: Clinical protocol elements, dose escalation, safety monitoring and outcome assessment for individualised ASOs.
oligo_applicability: Applies to individualised ASO INDs.

title: Considerations for the Use of the Plausible Mechanism Framework to Develop Individualized Therapies That Target Specific Genetic Conditions with Known Biological Cause (Draft Guidance for Industry)
status: draft (Feb 2026; 60-day comment period expected to end ~2026-04-27)
scope: Evidence framework for individualised genome-editing and RNA-based therapies (explicitly ASOs): single externally controlled investigation with natural-history control plus post-approval confirmatory plan; master/platform protocols; traditional or accelerated approval.
oligo_applicability: The 2025-2026 FDA framework for bespoke oligonucleotides; builds on the 2021 individualised-ASO guidances and the Nov 2025 NEJM article by FDA leadership (doi:10.1056/NEJMsb2512695).
verification: V-PAGE (FDA PDF first pages; law-firm summary)
notes: Docket number not stated in the PDF; obtain from the Federal Register notice.

title: Concept paper on the establishment of a guideline on the development and manufacture of synthetic oligonucleotides
status: final concept paper (consultation 2022-09-20 to 2022-12-20); superseded by draft guideline
scope: Rationale and scope for a dedicated EU quality guideline for synthetic oligonucleotides.
oligo_applicability: Historical/contextual; see draft guideline.

title: Guideline on the development and manufacture of oligonucleotides (draft)
status: draft (consultation 2024-07-22 to 2025-01-31; adoption not stated on EMA page as of 2026-10-28)
scope: Manufacturing process, starting materials, characterisation, impurities, specifications and analytical control for synthetic oligonucleotides (human and veterinary); conjugation (e.g., GalNAc), active substance in solution, generics, personalised approaches, CTA requirements.
oligo_applicability: Will be the primary EU CMC reference for ASO/siRNA/aptamers and conjugates; use for IMPD/MAA Module 3 planning now.

title: European Pharmacopoeia texts applicable to synthetic oligonucleotides
status: unknown - no dedicated oligonucleotide general chapter verified
scope: Searches of edqm.eu and EMA material did not surface a dedicated Ph. Eur. general chapter or monograph for synthetic oligonucleotides; an EMA 2023 presentation notes only the general monograph 'Substances for pharmaceutical use' (2034) applies and that no oligo-specific purity limits exist in Ph. Eur.
oligo_applicability: Apply general monograph 2034 and general methods (2.2.x chromatography, 2.5.x, 2.6.x endotoxins) plus the EMA draft oligo guideline; check Pharmeuropa for any new draft chapter before citing.
verification: Negative result after searching edqm.eu newsroom and EMA presentation (V-PAGE)
notes: Marked unverified. If a chapter exists (e.g., in Supplement 11.x/12.x), its number could not be confirmed in this session.

title: USP standards for synthetic oligonucleotides (Reference Standards and general chapters)
issuing_body: USP (Biologics Monographs 1 - Peptides & Oligonucleotides Expert Committee)
status: unknown - no dedicated USP general chapter number verified
scope: USP offers phosphoramidite Reference Standards and an oligonucleotide standards programme; existing nucleic-acid chapters <1125>-<1130> address analytical techniques, not therapeutic oligonucleotide quality. A proposed general chapter specific to synthetic oligonucleotide therapeutics could not be verified.
oligo_applicability: Use USP Reference Standards for amidites; monitor Pharmacopeial Forum for a dedicated chapter.
verification: USP oligonucleotide standards page and Expert Committee work plan fetched (V-PAGE) - no chapter number listed
notes: URL is the USP oligonucleotide programme landing page (node/93176 resolved to it); chapter number left null rather than guessed.

title: Guideline for preclinical safety assessment of oligonucleotide therapeutics
issuing_body: Japan MHLW (PSEHB Pharmaceutical Evaluation Division) / PMDA English translation
scope: Nonclinical safety for hybridisation-based oligonucleotides (ASO, siRNA, miRNA); excludes mRNA, genome-editing RNA, nucleic-acid vaccines, CpG oligos.
oligo_applicability: Directly applicable in Japan; first regulator-issued nonclinical oligo guideline; aligned with OSWG recommendations.
verification: V-PAGE (PMDA PDF and PMDA nonclinical guideline list)

title: Points to Consider for Quality Assurance and Evaluation of Oligonucleotide Therapeutics
scope: Quality expectations (manufacturing, characterisation, impurities, specifications, stability) for oligonucleotide therapeutics.
oligo_applicability: Directly applicable in Japan; useful cross-reference for impurity classification.

title: Questions and Answers on 'Points to Consider for Quality Assurance and Evaluation of Oligonucleotide Therapeutics'
scope: Q&A clarifying the 2018 quality points-to-consider.
oligo_applicability: Directly applicable in Japan.

title: OSWG Recommended Approaches to the Nonclinical Pharmacokinetic (ADME) Characterization of Therapeutic Oligonucleotides
issuing_body: Oligonucleotide Safety Working Group (OSWG) - Berman CL et al.
scope: Recommended nonclinical ADME package: plasma/tissue PK, metabolite profiling, protein binding, excretion, species considerations for ASO/siRNA/conjugates.
oligo_applicability: Industry consensus referenced by regulators; not a regulatory document.

title: Oligo Safety Working Group Exaggerated Pharmacology Subcommittee Consensus Document
scope: Assessment of exaggerated (on-target) pharmacology in nonclinical species; use of surrogate oligonucleotides.
oligo_applicability: Basis for 'surrogate oligo' and species-relevance arguments in oligonucleotide tox programmes.
verification: DOI URL V-SEARCH; bibliographic details K

title: Recommendations for Safety Pharmacology Evaluations of Oligonucleotide-Based Therapeutics
scope: Adaptation of ICH S7A/S7B core battery for oligonucleotides.
oligo_applicability: Supports integrating safety pharmacology endpoints into repeat-dose NHP studies.

title: OSWG Recommendations for Genotoxicity Testing of Novel Oligonucleotide-Based Therapeutics
scope: When the ICH S2(R1) battery is needed for oligonucleotides with novel chemistries vs. well-characterised modifications.
oligo_applicability: Supports reduced genotoxicity testing arguments.

title: Considerations for Assessment of Reproductive and Developmental Toxicity of Oligonucleotide-Based Therapeutics
scope: DART strategy for oligonucleotides (species, placental transfer, timing).
oligo_applicability: Supports ICH S5(R3)-based DART design.

title: Recommendations of the Oligonucleotide Safety Working Group's Formulated Oligonucleotide Subcommittee for the Safety Assessment of Formulated Oligonucleotide-Based Therapeutics
scope: Nonclinical safety of lipid/polymer-formulated oligonucleotides (LNP siRNA): formulation vs. payload toxicity, excipient qualification.
oligo_applicability: Key reference for LNP-delivered siRNA programmes.

title: Assessing unintended hybridization-induced biological effects of oligonucleotides
issuing_body: OSWG off-target subcommittee - Lindow M et al.
scope: In silico and in vitro strategy for hybridisation-dependent off-target assessment.
oligo_applicability: Foundational reference adopted by FDA 2024 draft and Japan 2020 guideline for off-target evaluation.

title: Drug Products, Including Biological Products, that Contain Nanomaterials (Guidance for Industry)
scope: CMC, nonclinical and clinical considerations for products containing nanomaterials (1-100 nm and up to 1 um) in the finished dosage form.
oligo_applicability: Applies to LNP-formulated siRNA/ASO and polymeric nanoparticle delivery systems.

title: Liposome Drug Products: Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls; Human Pharmacokinetics and Bioavailability; and Labeling Documentation (Guidance for Industry)
scope: CMC (lipid components, characterisation, stability), PK/BA and labelling for liposomal products.
oligo_applicability: Closest FDA CMC analogue for LNP-siRNA (patisiran precedent); lipid excipient characterisation expectations transfer.
verification: PDF URL V-SEARCH; docket not retrieved

title: Nonclinical Studies for the Safety Evaluation of Pharmaceutical Excipients (Guidance for Industry)
scope: Nonclinical data expected for new excipients by route and duration of use.
oligo_applicability: Governs qualification of novel ionisable lipids/PEG-lipids in LNPs and novel conjugate moieties when treated as excipients.

title: Novel Excipient Review Pilot Program (now 'Pilot Program for the Review of Innovation and Modernization of Excipients (PRIME)')
status: pilot programme (launched 2021; renamed; check current intake status)
scope: Voluntary FDA review of novel excipients outside a specific drug application (toxicology and quality package).
oligo_applicability: Route to pre-qualify novel LNP lipids independent of a given siRNA product.
verification: URL V-SEARCH (fda.gov); page content not fetched (site error)

title: Clinical Pharmacology Considerations for Antibody-Drug Conjugates (Guidance for Industry)
scope: Bioanalysis, dosing, exposure-response, intrinsic factors, QTc, immunogenicity and DDI for ADCs with cytotoxic small-molecule payloads (oncology).
oligo_applicability: Not written for antibody-oligonucleotide conjugates (AOCs) but is the nearest FDA framework; expect analogous expectations (conjugate, total antibody, free payload bioanalysis).

title: Immunogenicity Assessment for Therapeutic Protein Products (Guidance for Industry)
scope: Risk-based immunogenicity assessment and mitigation for therapeutic proteins.
oligo_applicability: Applies to the antibody component of AOCs; FDA oligo clin-pharm guidance separately covers ADA for oligonucleotides.

title: Reflection paper on the data requirements for intravenous liposomal products developed with reference to an innovator liposomal product
scope: Quality, nonclinical and clinical data for liposomal products (follow-on context).
oligo_applicability: EU reference for LNP characterisation expectations (size, PDI, encapsulation, lipid impurities, release).

title: Guideline on excipients in the dossier for application for marketing authorisation of a medicinal product
scope: Documentation for excipients in MAA, including novel excipients (full drug-substance-like data in 3.2.A.3).
oligo_applicability: Defines EU data package for novel LNP lipids and other new excipients.
verification: Title/reference V-SEARCH (TGA mirror of EMA text); EMA URL K

title: Reflection paper on nanotechnology-based medicinal products for human use
scope: General regulatory considerations for nanomedicines in the EU.
oligo_applicability: High-level EU context for LNP-oligonucleotides; complemented by the liposomal reflection paper and the surface-coatings reflection paper (EMA/325027/2013).

title: Guideline on development, production, characterisation and specification for monoclonal antibodies and related products (Revision 1)
status: in force (effective 2016-09-01); revision (Rev. 2) at concept-paper stage (EMA/CHMP/BWP/245588/2023)
scope: Quality requirements for mAbs and related products including conjugates.
oligo_applicability: Governs the antibody component of AOCs in the EU; conjugate-specific CMC per EMA draft oligo guideline (conjugation section).

title: Q6B: Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria for Biotechnological/Biological Products
scope: Specifications for biotech products.
oligo_applicability: Antibody component of AOCs; synthetic oligonucleotide payload follows Q6A.

title: Q5E: Comparability of Biotechnological/Biological Products Subject to Changes in Their Manufacturing Process
scope: Comparability exercise after manufacturing changes for biotech products.
oligo_applicability: Antibody/protein carriers of conjugated oligonucleotides.

title: Regulation (EC) No 1901/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council on medicinal products for paediatric use (Paediatric Regulation)
document_number: Regulation (EC) No 1901/2006 (CELEX 32006R1901); amended by Regulation (EC) No 1902/2006
status: in force (to be replaced by the 2026 EU pharma package after transition)
scope: PIP obligation, waivers/deferrals, PDCO, compliance check, 6-month SPC extension reward, PUMA, 2-year orphan exclusivity extension.
oligo_applicability: All oligonucleotide MAAs for new active substances need an agreed PIP or waiver; product-specific waivers common for adult-only diseases; class/mechanism-based obligations expected to expand under the new legislation.
verification: V-SEARCH (EUR-Lex ELI) and EMA orphan legal-framework page

title: Commission guideline on the format and content of applications for agreement or modification of a paediatric investigation plan and requests for waivers or deferrals, and concerning the operation of the compliance check and criteria for assessing significant studies
scope: PIP application format/content, modifications, waivers, deferrals, compliance check.
oligo_applicability: Procedural basis for PIP submissions for oligonucleotides.
verification: K (OJ reference from knowledge; not fetched)

title: Paediatric investigation plans: questions and answers (incl. Section 5 'Stepwise paediatric investigation plans (sPIPs)')
scope: Operational Q&A on PIP submission, modification, stepwise PIPs, compliance.
oligo_applicability: Stepwise PIP is well suited to oligonucleotide programmes in rare/oncology indications where later studies cannot be defined early.

title: Review of the stepwise paediatric investigation plan (sPIP) pilot: outcomes and future perspectives
status: final report (pilot 2023-2025; integration into routine practice planned)
scope: Outcome of the sPIP pilot: 27 eligibility requests, 8 sPIPs adopted, mostly rare disease/oncology.
oligo_applicability: Precedent and process description for staged PIPs for oligonucleotides.

title: EU pharmaceutical package: Regulation laying down Union procedures for the authorisation and supervision of medicinal products for human use and rules governing the EMA (2023/0131(COD)) and Directive on the Union code relating to medicinal products for human use (2023/0132(COD))
issuing_body: European Parliament and Council (Commission proposal April 2023)
status: adopted by Council 2026-09-28 after provisional agreement 2025-12-11; European Parliament formal adoption / OJ publication pending as of sources dated Sept-Oct 2026; application ~24 months after entry into force (c. 2028)
scope: Replaces Directive 2001/83/EC, Regulation 726/2004 and folds in the Paediatric (1901/2006) and Orphan (141/2000) Regulations: 8-year data protection + 1-year market protection (extendable, cap 11 years; 12 with voucher), modulated orphan exclusivity (9 years standard, 11 for 'breakthrough' orphan products, +12 months for new orphan indication), product-based orphan approach, PIP reform (mechanism-of-action-based obligations, stepwise PIPs recognised).
oligo_applicability: Will govern paediatric obligations and orphan exclusivity for oligonucleotide MAAs filed after application date; transitional rules keep current regime for pending applications. Official act numbers (Regulation (EU) 2026/xxx, Directive (EU) 2026/xxx) not yet assigned - do not cite numbers.
verification: V-PAGE (Council press release Dec 2025; law-firm/GMP-news summaries Jun-Oct 2026); final act numbers unverified

title: Pediatric Research Equity Act (PREA) - FD&C Act section 505B (Research into pediatric uses for drugs and biological products)
status: in force (as amended by FDAAA 2007, FDASIA 2012, FDARA 2017)
scope: Mandatory paediatric assessments for new active ingredients/indications/dosage forms; iPSP requirement; waivers/deferrals; orphan exemption (except molecularly targeted oncology drugs post-RACE).
oligo_applicability: Oligonucleotides with orphan designation are exempt from PREA unless the RACE provision applies (molecular target relevant to paediatric cancer).

title: Best Pharmaceuticals for Children Act (BPCA) - FD&C Act section 505A (Pediatric studies of drugs)
scope: Voluntary paediatric studies under Written Request in exchange for 6-month paediatric exclusivity.
oligo_applicability: Incentive route for paediatric oligonucleotide studies.

title: Research to Accelerate Cures and Equity (RACE) for Children Act - FDA Reauthorization Act of 2017, Title V section 504, amending FD&C Act 505B
status: in force (applies to applications submitted on/after 2020-08-18)
scope: Requires paediatric investigation of new adult oncology drugs directed at a molecular target substantially relevant to paediatric cancer; removes orphan exemption for such drugs.
oligo_applicability: Oligonucleotides targeting oncogenic fusions/transcripts on the Pediatric Molecular Target List trigger mandatory paediatric plans even with orphan designation.

title: FDA Pediatric Molecular Target Lists (Relevant Molecular Target List; Non-Relevant Molecular Target Leading to Waiver List)
scope: Lists of molecular targets deemed relevant/non-relevant to paediatric cancer growth for RACE Act implementation (XLSX files at fda.gov/media/161463 and /161462).
oligo_applicability: Determines whether an oncology oligonucleotide's target triggers paediatric study obligations.

title: FDARA Implementation Guidance for Pediatric Studies of Molecularly Targeted Oncology Drugs: Amendments to Sec. 505B of the FD&C Act (Guidance for Industry)
scope: How FDA implements RACE Act requirements: molecular target relevance, iPSP timing, waivers/deferrals, same-in-class considerations.
oligo_applicability: Procedural roadmap for oncology oligonucleotides with paediatric-relevant targets.

title: Pediatric Study Plans: Content of and Process for Submitting Initial Pediatric Study Plans and Amended Initial Pediatric Study Plans (Guidance for Industry)
scope: iPSP content, timing (end of Phase 2), agreement process and amendments under FD&C 505B(e).
oligo_applicability: Applies to any oligonucleotide NDA/BLA subject to PREA.

title: Regulation (EC) No 141/2000 of the European Parliament and of the Council on orphan medicinal products
status: in force (to be replaced by the 2026 EU pharma package)
scope: Orphan designation criteria (prevalence <= 5/10,000 or insufficient return), protocol assistance, fee reductions, 10-year market exclusivity.
oligo_applicability: Most oligonucleotide indications (rare genetic, rare cancers) qualify; similarity/clinical-superiority rules matter for follow-on oligos against the same target.

title: Commission Regulation (EC) No 847/2000 laying down the provisions for implementation of the criteria for designation of a medicinal product as an orphan medicinal product and definitions of 'similar medicinal product' and 'clinical superiority'
scope: Definitions of similar medicinal product (incl. same principal molecular structural features) and clinical superiority.
oligo_applicability: Determines whether a second oligonucleotide against the same target is 'similar' (sequence/chemistry) for exclusivity purposes.

title: Commission Notice on the application of Articles 3, 5 and 7 of Regulation (EC) No 141/2000 on orphan medicinal products
scope: Interpretation of designation criteria, significant benefit, and maintenance at MA.
oligo_applicability: Significant-benefit demonstration for oligonucleotides vs. authorised therapies.

title: Commission guideline on the format and content of applications for designation as orphan medicinal products and on the transfer of designations from one sponsor to another
scope: Format/content of orphan designation applications.
oligo_applicability: Procedural.

title: Regulation (EC) No 726/2004 laying down Union procedures for the authorisation and supervision of medicinal products for human use and establishing a European Medicines Agency
document_number: Regulation (EC) No 726/2004 (Art. 14(9) accelerated assessment; Art. 14-a conditional MA; Art. 3 mandatory centralised scope)
status: in force (to be replaced by the 2026 EU pharma package)
scope: Centralised procedure, accelerated assessment (150 days), conditional MA, exceptional circumstances.
oligo_applicability: Orphan and biotech-process products are mandatory centralised; synthetic oligonucleotides for orphan indications therefore go centralised.

title: Commission Regulation (EC) No 507/2006 on the conditional marketing authorisation for medicinal products for human use falling within the scope of Regulation (EC) No 726/2004
scope: Criteria for conditional MA (positive benefit-risk, unmet need, likely comprehensive data, benefit of immediate availability).
oligo_applicability: Common pathway for oligonucleotides approved on surrogate endpoints (e.g., exon-skipping, TTR).

title: Guideline on the scientific application and the practical arrangements necessary to implement Commission Regulation (EC) No 507/2006 on the conditional marketing authorisation for medicinal products for human use falling within the scope of Regulation (EC) No 726/2004
scope: How to apply for and maintain a conditional MA; specific obligations; conversion to standard MA.
oligo_applicability: Procedural reference for surrogate-endpoint oligonucleotide approvals.
verification: V-SEARCH (EMA PDF); reference number V-PAGE (EMA presentation)

title: Guideline on the scientific application and the practical arrangements necessary to implement the procedure for accelerated assessment pursuant to Article 14(9) of Regulation (EC) No 726/2004
scope: Eligibility (major public health interest, unmet need), request timing, 150-day timetable.
oligo_applicability: PRIME products are automatically eligible; relevant for oligonucleotides in severe rare diseases.

title: Enhanced early dialogue to facilitate accelerated assessment of PRIority MEdicines (PRIME)
status: in force (scheme launched March 2016; document last updated 2018-05-07); applicant guidance EMA/7872/2021 updated 2026-06-30
scope: PRIME eligibility (unmet need, major therapeutic advantage, exploratory clinical data; early entry for SMEs/academia), rapporteur appointment, kick-off meeting, scientific advice, accelerated assessment.
oligo_applicability: Several ASO/siRNA products have held PRIME; EMA-FDA joint Q&A on quality/GMP for PRIME/BTD products (EMA/CHMP/531552/2023) addresses CMC acceleration.

title: Orphan Drug Act provisions - FD&C Act sections 525-529 (orphan designation, protocol assistance, 7-year exclusivity, grants, rare pediatric disease vouchers)
document_number: 21 U.S.C. 360aa-360ff (Pub. L. 97-414 as amended; orphan exclusivity scope clarified by Pub. L. 119-75, 2026)
scope: Orphan designation (<200,000 US patients), 7-year marketing exclusivity, tax credit, user-fee waiver.
oligo_applicability: Standard route for rare-disease oligonucleotides; 2026 amendment narrows exclusivity to the approved use/indication (abrogating Catalyst v. Becerra), enabling paediatric sub-indications.
verification: Statute K; 2026 amendment V-PAGE (JD Supra summary of Pub. L. 119-75)

title: 21 CFR Part 316 - Orphan Drugs
scope: Orphan designation procedure, 'same drug' definition, clinical superiority, exclusivity.
oligo_applicability: 'Same drug' for oligonucleotides is judged on principal molecular structural features; relevant for competing sequences.

title: Expedited Programs for Serious Conditions - Drugs and Biologics (Guidance for Industry)
status: final (May 2014; accelerated-approval content to be replaced by Dec 2024 draft once finalised)
scope: Fast Track (FD&C 506(b)), Breakthrough Therapy (506(a)), Accelerated Approval (506(c)), Priority Review: criteria, procedures, evidence.
oligo_applicability: Breakthrough/Fast Track frequently granted to oligonucleotides for serious rare diseases on preliminary clinical evidence.
verification: FR citation V-PAGE (79 FR 31117 via Dec 2024 FR notice); media URL K

title: Expedited Program for Serious Conditions - Accelerated Approval of Drugs and Biologics (Draft Guidance for Industry)
scope: Implements FDORA (Consolidated Appropriations Act 2023, Pub. L. 117-328 sec. 3210): confirmatory trials underway before approval, expedited withdrawal, surrogate endpoint justification.
oligo_applicability: Governs surrogate-endpoint approvals typical for oligonucleotides (e.g., dystrophin, biomarker-based); confirmatory trial must be enrolling at approval.
verification: V-PAGE (Federal Register notice); FDA media URL not retrieved

title: FD&C Act section 506 - Expedited approval of drugs for serious or life-threatening diseases or conditions (Breakthrough Therapy, Fast Track, Accelerated Approval)
document_number: 21 U.S.C. 356 (as amended by FDASIA 2012 sec. 902 and FDORA 2022)
scope: Statutory basis of Breakthrough Therapy designation, Fast Track, and Accelerated Approval with FDORA confirmatory-study conditions; implementing regulations 21 CFR 314 Subpart H and 21 CFR 601 Subpart E.
oligo_applicability: Statutory basis for the expedited designations used by most oligonucleotide programmes.

title: Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher program - FD&C Act section 529, reauthorised by the Mikaela Naylon Give Kids a Chance Act (Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026, secs. 6601-6605)
status: in force - designations restored through 2029-09-30 (program had lapsed 2024-12-20)
scope: Rare pediatric disease designation and award of transferable priority review vouchers upon approval of qualifying applications.
oligo_applicability: Important incentive for paediatric-onset rare-disease oligonucleotides (SMA, Batten, DMD precedents); request designation before NDA submission.
verification: Reauthorisation V-PAGE (JD Supra, Feb 2026); statute URL K

title: Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Vouchers (Draft Guidance for Industry)
issuing_body: FDA (CBER, CDER, Office of Orphan Products Development)
scope: Definitions (rare pediatric disease, 'primarily affects' 0-18 years), designation requests, voucher award and transfer.
oligo_applicability: Procedural reference for RPD designation requests.

title: Rare Diseases: Considerations for the Development of Drugs and Biological Products (Guidance for Industry)
status: final (Dec 2023; finalises 2019 draft 'Rare Diseases: Common Issues in Drug Development')
scope: Natural history, biomarkers/surrogates, nonclinical flexibility, trial design, evidence of effectiveness in rare diseases.
oligo_applicability: Framework for most oligonucleotide indications; cross-reference with RDEP and plausible-mechanism framework.

title: CDER/CBER Rare Disease Evidence Principles (RDEP)
status: in force (agency process, not a guidance document)
scope: Process for therapies addressing a known genetic defect in very small populations (<~1,000 US patients) with rapid deterioration and no alternatives: approval on one adequate and well-controlled study plus robust confirmatory evidence (mechanistic, biomarker, natural history, expanded access data); request before pivotal trial.
oligo_applicability: Tailored to genetically targeted oligonucleotides in ultra-rare disease; complements the Feb 2026 plausible-mechanism draft guidance.

title: Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council on clinical trials on medicinal products for human use, and repealing Directive 2001/20/EC (Clinical Trials Regulation)
status: in force (applicable since 2022-01-31; transition from Directive 2001/20/EC ended 2025-01-30)
scope: Single CTA via CTIS, Part I/Part II assessment, low-intervention trials, transparency, safety reporting; Annex I application dossier incl. IMPD.
oligo_applicability: All EU oligonucleotide trials; IMPD quality per EMA IMP guideline and draft oligo guideline; paediatric trials need Part II ethics focus.

title: Clinical Trials Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 - Questions & Answers (EudraLex Volume 10)
scope: Interpretation of CTR provisions (scope, substantial modifications, transition, safety reporting, CTIS use); EudraLex Vol. 10 also hosts 2025-10-30 updates (RMS selection, decentralised elements, Part I/II frequent issues, auxiliary medicinal products).
oligo_applicability: Procedural; relevant for individualised ASO trials (classification of n-of-1 trials, substantial modification for sequence changes).
verification: Volume 10 page V-SEARCH; current Q&A version number not verified

title: Guideline on the requirements for the chemical and pharmaceutical quality documentation concerning investigational medicinal products in clinical trials (Revision 2)
status: in force (Rev. 2; Rev. 1 requirements applied from 2018-05-28)
scope: IMPD-Q content for chemical IMPs by phase (S/P sections, specifications, stability, GMP).
oligo_applicability: Governs IMPD quality for synthetic oligonucleotides in EU CTAs; the EMA draft oligo guideline adds oligo-specific CTA expectations.
verification: EMA page V-PAGE (Rev. 2 current; reference number and adoption date from knowledge)

title: Guideline on strategies to identify and mitigate risks for first-in-human and early clinical trials with investigational medicinal products (Revision 1)
scope: Integrated protocols, dose selection (MABEL/NOAEL), sentinel dosing, stopping rules for FIH/early trials.
oligo_applicability: Applies to FIH oligonucleotide trials; dose selection should consider tissue accumulation and class effects (complement activation, thrombocytopenia).

title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/1569 specifying principles of and guidelines for good manufacturing practice for investigational medicinal products for human use and arrangements for inspections
scope: GMP for IMPs under the CTR; manufacturing/import authorisation.
oligo_applicability: GMP expectations for oligonucleotide IMP manufacture (incl. academic bespoke ASO supply).

title: 21 CFR Part 312 - Investigational New Drug Application
scope: IND content (312.23), 30-day review, clinical holds, sponsor/investigator obligations, expanded access (Subpart I), exploratory IND. Related: 21 CFR 50 (informed consent), 56 (IRB), 58 (GLP).
oligo_applicability: All US oligonucleotide trials; sponsor-investigator INDs for individualised ASOs follow the 2021 FDA guidances.

title: Content and Format of Investigational New Drug Applications (INDs) for Phase 1 Studies of Drugs, Including Well-Characterized, Therapeutic, Biotechnology-derived Products (Guidance for Industry)
scope: Phase 1 IND CMC, pharmacology/toxicology and clinical content expectations.
oligo_applicability: Baseline for oligonucleotide Phase 1 INDs; CMC expectations supplemented by FDA oligo-specific review practice.

title: Investigational New Drug Applications Prepared and Submitted by Sponsor-Investigators (Draft Guidance for Industry)
scope: IND preparation for academic sponsor-investigators.
oligo_applicability: Relevant for academic n-of-1 ASO programmes alongside the individualised-ASO guidances.

title: The Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004
status: in force (as amended; substantially amended by SI 2025/538 from 2026-04-28)
scope: UK clinical trial authorisation, ethics review, GCP, safety reporting (originally implementing Directive 2001/20/EC).
oligo_applicability: Legal basis for UK CTAs for oligonucleotides.

title: The Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) (Amendment) Regulations 2025
scope: Reform of UK trial approval (combined MHRA/REC review, risk-proportionate timelines, notification scheme for low-risk trials), ethics committee and safety reporting rules.
oligo_applicability: Current UK regime for oligonucleotide trials; transitional arrangements per MHRA guidance (gov.uk/guidance/clinical-trials-regulations-transitional-arrangements).

title: Clinical trials for medicines: apply for approval in the UK (MHRA guidance)
status: in force (web guidance, updated for 2026 regime)
scope: Combined review via IRAS, timelines, documents (IMPD, IB), amendments.
oligo_applicability: Procedural for UK oligonucleotide CTAs.
